reports.title: DigitalOcean Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: DigitalOcean is providing guidance for the fourth quarter ending December 31, 2026 as follows:
•Total revenue of $348 to $351 million, up 44% to 45% year-over-year.
•Non-GAAP diluted net income per share of $0.30 to $0.32.
•Fully diluted weighted average shares outstanding of approximately 128 to 129 million shares.
